snippet.title: Virago full game trailer + release date announcement
snippet.description:
Thank you all for the support on my indie game! Here is the release date for my indie game. Hope you guys like the trailer. Please like, share and comment so youtube can recommend this video to more people! 
Music by https://youtube.com/jordan_composer

you can learn more about the game here: https://viragolinks.carrd.co
